snippet.title: Mashina - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet Mashina, her friends, and learn about her adventure in this Mashina trailer for the upcoming digging adventure by the developers behind Judero. You play as Mashina, a friendly mining robot tasked with finding minerals to help mend, build and nurture her quirky robot community. Mashina will be available on PC on July 31, 2025.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3395930/Mashina/
